title: Add retired-root canonical-root guard for legacy Orchestrate checkout
description: Prevent future Host or Agent sessions from accidentally creating, advancing, validating, or writing Lattice evidence in the retired /Users/jek/Documents/Work/Orchestrate checkout after active worktrees were migrated to /Users/jek/Documents/Work/proofbound.
